name: Transient Photon Beams
definition: A numerical solution for rendering participating media in transient state that extends the steady-state Photon Beams algorithm by accounting for photon time-of-flight along continuous beam trajectories, using 2D density estimation to mitigate variance.
summary: Transient Photon Beams is a numerical method for rendering participating media in the transient state that combines density estimation efficiency with temporal accuracy by evenly distributing integrated radiance over temporal intervals.
